display.purpose: Page H1 only ("Reaction Time Test"). Fixed rem, sans, tight tracking.

readout.purpose: The signature. Every measured value — reaction time, average, personal best — in oversized monospace so digits never reflow.

headline.purpose: Test-area state messages (Wait / GO / Too soon) and result emphasis.

body.purpose: Supporting copy in Ink Secondary; cap at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Setting labels, attempt labels, rank-badge text (0.05em tracking, capitalized).

shadows.name: structural-md
shadows.purpose: Neutral depth for genuinely floating surfaces (modal). Used sparingly.

shadows.name: glow-accent
shadows.purpose: State telemetry: GO state and primary-button hover. Means active / go.

shadows.name: glow-hold
shadows.purpose: State telemetry: waiting and false-start states. Means hold / error.

shadows.name: glow-rank-elite
shadows.purpose: Session-complete results border, colored to the achieved rank (elite shown; each rank has its own).

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Default for interactive state (buttons, toggles, nav).

motion.name: pulse-text
motion.purpose: Breathing status text while holding (waiting state).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The green go-signal CTA ("Try Again", start actions). Dark text on Signal Green; hover deepens, lifts, and glows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:.5rem 1.5rem; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#0a0a0b; background:#22c55e; border:1px solid #22c55e; border-radius:.75rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#16a34a; border-color:#16a34a; transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(34,197,94,.2),0 0 40px rgba(34,197,94,.2); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c55e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent, hairline-bordered neutral action ("Cancel"). Hover fills to panel-hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:.5rem 1.5rem; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; color:#fafafa; background:transparent; border:1px solid #27272a; border-radius:.75rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#1f1f23; border-color:#71717a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c55e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Setting Toggle Group
components.description: Segmented single-select for test settings (count, delay, input). The active option recesses to chassis-black with a Signal-Green border.
components.css: .ds-toggle-group { display:flex; gap:.5rem; } .ds-toggle { min-width:44px; padding:.5rem 1rem; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; color:#a1a1aa; background:#18181b; border:1px solid #27272a; border-radius:.5rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms ease; } .ds-toggle:hover { background:#1f1f23; border-color:#71717a; color:#fafafa; } .ds-toggle--active { background:#0a0a0b; border-color:#22c55e; color:#fafafa; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #22c55e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Rank Badge
components.description: Telemetry capsule using a rank hue at three intensities (full-hue text, 20% fill, 30% border). The one licensed burst of extra color.
components.css: .ds-rank { display:inline-block; padding:.25rem 1rem; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:capitalize; border-radius:.375rem; } .ds-rank--pro { color:#22c55e; background:rgba(34,197,94,.2); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.3); } .ds-rank--elite { color:#a855f7; background:rgba(168,85,247,.2); border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.3); }

components.name: Widget Card
components.description: Flat telemetry card (personal best, trend, rank). No resting shadow — separated by tone + hairline. Metric set in the monospace readout face.
components.css: .ds-widget { background:#141416; border:1px solid #27272a; border-radius:1rem; padding:1.5rem; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-widget__title { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; color:#fafafa; margin:0 0 1rem; } .ds-widget__title svg { color:#22c55e; } .ds-widget__metric { font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Monaco,monospace; font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; color:#22c55e; line-height:1; } .ds-widget__unit { font-family:-apple-system,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; color:#a1a1aa; margin-left:.25rem; }

components.name: Test Area (idle)
components.description: The signature instrument face at rest. Cycles through idle/waiting/GO/false-start/complete states; idle shown. State is always paired with text + motion, never color alone.

narrative.overview: ReflexLab is not a game skin and not a dashboard — it is a precision measuring instrument rendered in software. Picture a piece of dark lab equipment: a black chassis, a single green signal light, a monospace readout, and nothing on the panel that isn't earning its place. The user is here to get one honest number — their reaction time in milliseconds — and to chase it downward. Every visual decision serves that reading. The one saturated color on the surface, Signal Green, behaves like an instrument's indicator LED: it means go, active, or personal-best, never decoration. The system is dark by physical necessity, not fashion — the core interaction is a red→green state change the user must catch in ~250ms, and a dark surround maximizes the contrast of that flash. It explicitly rejects the cheesy ad-cluttered reaction-test genre (no ad slots, no interstitials crowding the measurement) and the loud RGB-gamer aesthetic (no neon-everything, no carbon-fiber skins, no gradient soup). The energy is real but controlled, the way a serious instrument is controlled; green is powerful precisely because it is rationed.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument, not arcade — a calibrated measuring device that keeps score, not a light show.
The number is the hero — monospace readout, oversized, dead-center; the chrome around it stays quiet.
One rationed accent — Signal Green marks go / active / best only; the rank palette is the sole licensed exception.
Dark by function — the black chassis exists to make the red→green signal unmistakable.
Charged but controlled — glow and motion appear only as state feedback, never as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green and Hold Red are the game's language — go and wait. They may only ever mean that. Never fill a card, header, or decorative shape with either.

rules.name: The Rank-Only Color Rule
rules.body: The five rank hues (violet / green / blue / amber / gray) are licensed for rank badges and the results-border glow — nowhere else. Color is telemetry, not upholstery.

rules.name: The Monospace-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every measured value — reaction times, averages, PBs — is set in the monospace readout face. Proportional numerals in a measurement are forbidden; digits must never reflow.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-A-Signal Rule
rules.body: Colored glow is state telemetry, not ambience. It appears on waiting (red), GO (green), primary-CTA hover (green), and session-complete (rank color). Nowhere else.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, widgets, and panels carry no resting drop shadow. Separation from the chassis is tone + 1px hairline. Reserve true black shadows for the modal, which genuinely floats.

dos: Do keep Signal Green (#22c55e) rationed to go / active / your best and the Pro rank. Emphasis elsewhere comes from weight, size, and tone — not more green.
Do set every measured value in the monospace readout face so digits never reflow.
Do build depth from the panel tone ramp (#0a0a0b → #111113 → #141416 → #18181b) plus 1px hairlines. Keep cards flat at rest.
Do treat colored glow as state telemetry only — red hold, green GO, green CTA-hover, rank result.

Do pair every red/green state with a non-color cue — a text label and a motion — so red-green color-blind players can play. Ship a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for each, and keep GO a clean state change, not a strobe.
Do hold body text at ≥4.5:1 against its panel; use Ink Secondary (#a1a1aa) or brighter, not Ink Muted, on card surfaces.
Do give every interactive element the shared vocabulary: dark neutral fill, 1px hairline, scale radius, 150ms transition, green :focus-visible ring.
donts: Don't drift toward the cheesy, ad-cluttered reaction-test look — no ad slots, interstitials, popups, or CTAs crowding the measurement.
Don't slide into the loud RGB-gamer aesthetic — no neon-everything, angular carbon-fiber/hexagon skins, dragon motifs, or gradient soup.
Don't use Signal Green or Hold Red for anything other than their state meaning (The One Signal Rule).
Don't let the rank palette (violet / blue / amber / gray) leak beyond rank badges and the results-border glow.
Don't add resting drop shadows to cards or widgets, and don't reach for glassmorphism — depth is tone + hairline; glow is reserved for state.
Don't signal any test state by color alone, and don't ship a flashing/strobing GO transition.
Don't carry essential body copy in Ink Muted (#71717a) at small sizes on card surfaces — it lands on the AA contrast line.
Don't introduce a second UI font or a display face. One sans in multiple weights, one mono for numbers.
